_about: Hand-checked corrections applied on top of STEPBible TIPNR by scripts/build-people.py. STEPBible's licence asks that changes to its data be visible to users of the new data, so every entry says why. Consider sending corrections upstream to STEPBible@Gmail.com.

spans.note: Judas Iscariot (Acts 1:16-20); chapter also names Judas son of James (1:13).
Apostle John with Peter; chapter also names John of the high priest's family (4:6).
'Simon called Peter'; chapter also names Simon the tanner.
Barnabas and Saul sent out; chapter also names King Saul (13:21-22).
King Saul removed in favour of David.
The BSB spells Titius Justus 'Titus Justus'; not Paul's companion Titus.
'Jehoram king of Judah', father of Ahaziah; not Joram son of Ahab, named later in the verse.
Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
Father of Jeroboam II, king of Israel.
Hermes and Hermas are two people greeted in the same verse.
Listed among Reuben's clans (26:5-7), so Reuben's son, not Judah's grandson.
Meshelemiah's father, the gatekeeper Kore of 1 Chr 9:19, not Korah the rebel.

replace.note: The Caesar Paul appeals to under Festus (governor from about AD 59) is Nero; Claudius died in AD 54.
